tool_input.command: cd "/c/visual projects/alpha" && S="ssh -i $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa -o UserKnownHostsFile=$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts deck@192.168.1.49"; mkdir -p /tmp/p02jul/old && cp tools/compute/{p02-stage2-recompute.sh,p02-wave3-flow-recompute.sh,p02-wave3-flow-join.py,p02-g33-recompute.sh,p02-g33-causal-join.py,p02-wall2.py,p02-wave3-analyze.py,p02-g33-analyze.py,p02-g36-causal.py,p02-jul-blockA-day.sh,p02-jul-blockA-collect.sh} /tmp/p02jul/ && cp data/p02/{p02-wall2,p02-wave3,p02-g33,p02-g36}-counts-2026-09-26.json /tmp/p02jul/old/ && tar -C /tmp/p02jul -cf - . | $S 'mkdir -p ~/alpha/tmp-p02jul && tar -C ~/alpha/tmp-p02jul -xf - && cd ~/alpha/tmp-p02jul && sed -i "s/\r$//" *.sh *.py && chmod +x *.sh && ls old && bash -n p02-jul-blockA-day.sh && bash -n p02-jul-blockA-collect.sh && python3 -m py_compile p02-wall2.py && echo OK; cmp <(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open(\"old/p02-wall2-counts-2026-09-26.json\"))[\"thresholds\"]==json.load(open(\"../study/p02c/p02-wall2-thresholds.json\")))") <(echo True) && echo thr-same'; rm -rf /tmp/p02jul
tool_input.description: Upload scripts and old counts to deck
